title: Membership Desk Cross-Notice: The Share of a Credit Let Go on One Sale
content:
The share of the credit still available that may go toward one sale under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is widened for members of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme standing above Belrose Circle Silver, and how far depends on how many credits the programme lets go on one sale.

## The notice

Where the programme allows more than one credit on one sale and the customer's membership stands above Belrose Circle Silver, the share is the whole of the credit still available (100 percent). Where the programme allows only one credit on one sale and the customer's membership stands above Belrose Circle Silver, the share is eighty percent (80 percent). Otherwise the share is the one the desk lets go on one sale, sixty percent (60 percent).

A membership stands above Belrose Circle Silver when its tier is Belrose Circle Gold, Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black or the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. The number of credits a programme allows on one sale is its published figure.

## Programme and membership together

| Programme | Credits allowed on one sale | Membership above Belrose Circle Silver | Share |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 2 | yes | 100 percent |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 2 | yes | 100 percent |
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 1 | yes | 80 percent |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 1 | yes | 80 percent |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 1 | yes | 80 percent |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 1 | yes | 80 percent |
| any | any | no (Member or Silver) | 60 percent |

## Readings on a credit still available of 10000 USD

- A Belrose Circle Black member under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee: 10000.00 USD.
- A Belrose Circle Gold member under the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee: 8000.00 USD.
- A Belrose Circle Silver member under either: 6000.00 USD.
